title: Avoiding Peanuts Raised Allergy Risk To 13.7%
hook: The old peanut advice produced the worse result.
closing: Medical advice should change when evidence shows a safer path for families.
question: Would you introduce peanut early?

segments.say: Peanut allergy reached 1.4% among US children while parents were advised to keep babies away from peanuts.
Peanut avoidance led to 13.7% allergy risk, while early eating produced a far lower rate.
After early-peanut guidelines, diagnoses fell to 0.45%, an encouraging shift for young children.
